# fiddy

> Fiddy is a warm little Farcaster companion. It helps you read, post, and open mini apps with an agent that asks before it acts.

## Look around first

Public browsing needs no sign-in. Anyone can read the public feed and explore without an account. An account, agent pairing, and wallet access are separate choices, not requirements for reading About.

## You stay in control

Your agent explains what it wants to do, then waits for your yes. Fiddy keeps the choice with you.

## Straight answers

Fiddy reads through the service you choose in Settings. That can be your own setup or a hosted service you configured. If that service cannot answer something, fiddy says so in place instead of inventing a result.
